note: Marlboro County (SC) publishes its parcels only through its Think GIS viewer (marlborosc.wthgis.com), which exposes no public REST service (root returns 404). The only Marlboro parcel layer found, SCDOT SC_Parcels MapServer/33 (smpesri.scdot.org), returns 'Token Required' for both the service and layer, so it is login-gated and cannot be used. Other sources are commercial (Regrid, DynamoSpatial, acres) or lack a county service.
